input: Track every meal for a full two weeks

gold.taskTitle: Track every meal for a full two weeks
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to consistently log all meals over a 14-day period.

questions.title: What is your main reason for tracking meals?
questions.description: Understand the core motivation — weight loss, muscle gain, managing a health condition, general awareness, etc.

questions.title: Which app or method will you use to log?
questions.description: Identify the tracking tool — a phone app like MyFitnessPal, a paper journal, a spreadsheet, or something else.

questions.title: What exactly will you record for each meal?
questions.description: Clarify the level of detail — just food names, portion sizes, calories, macros, time of eating, hunger levels, etc.

questions.title: How many meals or eating occasions do you have daily?
questions.description: Establish the typical daily eating pattern — three main meals, plus snacks, intermittent fasting windows, etc.

questions.title: When do you plan to start the two weeks?
questions.description: Pin down the exact start date so the plan has a clear beginning and end point.

questions.title: What situations make consistent logging hardest for you?
questions.description: Surface known obstacles — eating out, busy workdays, social events, travel — so they can be planned around.

questions.title: How will you remind yourself to log each meal?
questions.description: Determine the accountability or reminder system — phone alarms, habit stacking, a tracking partner, etc.
